name: nopekit
description: Design and validate real physical things — hardware, enclosures, PCBs, boats, thermal systems, chemical processes. Extracts the claims that must be true, generates every output from one parametric model, gates each claim with a validator proven able to fail, and reports honestly what is verified versus assumed. Use when someone wants to design, build, fabricate, simulate, validate or manufacture a physical object or system.

interface.shortDescription: Design physical things, and check every claim
